patch_list: Neutralises the PairIP v2 signature gate (SignatureTamperedException) and the Play licence flow (service bind, signed-response validation, paywall and its delayed System.exit) so a re-signed Brotato build launches. Required for every other…
Every real-money shop, mall and DLC tile is granted locally the moment you tap it — no Play billing, no payment screen, no charge. Repeat purchases of the same tile keep working. Client-side only.
